name: Gnarlpine Corruption
summary: Near Starbreeze Village, Gnarlpine Corruption threatens Teldrassil. Wounded Great Warden Gaerolas Talvethren sends word to Dolanaar. Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun the village and fallen to demonic corruption. Their violence may reach the sleeping druids of Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

sections.title: A Desperate Warning
sections.body:
Near the ruins of Starbreeze Village, Gaerolas Talvethren lies grievously wounded. His former allies, the Gnarlpine furbolgs, ambushed him. Once peaceful neighbors and stewards of the wild, they have turned feral.

Too badly hurt to carry warning himself, Gaerolas sends you to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar. He fears the madness will spread farther through Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Scourge of Fel Moss
sections.body:
In Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle learns that fel magic has seized the Gnarlpine furbolgs. Their chieftain, Ursal the Mauler, has harnessed the corrupted Fel Moss festering within the World Tree. Its power drives his people into a violent frenzy.

The tribe threatens settlements such as Starbreeze. Nearby, sleeping druids lie defenseless in Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

faq.answer: Fel magic drove the Gnarlpine furbolgs to overrun and pillage Starbreeze Village. Their sudden ambush drove out or slaughtered its inhabitants. Gaerolas Talvethren was left trapped and wounded near the ruins.

faq.q: Why have the Gnarlpine furbolgs turned violent?
faq.answer: Ursal the Mauler has turned the Gnarlpine furbolgs against their former night elf allies. Their chieftain wields the evil power of Fel Moss found on Teldrassil, and its dark magic drives the tribe into an uncontrollable frenzy.

Gaerolas Talvethren is the night elf Great Warden of the sleeping Druids of the Talon. Gnarlpine furbolgs ambushed him as he traveled toward Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Wounded, he relies on travelers to carry news of the catastrophe to Dolanaar.
Athridas Bearmantle is a prominent night elf authority stationed in Dolanaar. He oversees regional security and helps coordinate responses to threats against the World Tree and its inhabitants.

faq.q: Why are the night elves worried about Ban'ethil Barrow Den?
faq.answer: Ban'ethil Barrow Den holds many druids deep in the Emerald Dream. If the frenzied Gnarlpine furbolgs reach the barrows, the sleeping night elves will be defenseless.
Fel Moss is a corrupted growth in Teldrassil, tainted by dark demonic energies. Its influence drives local wildlife and furbolgs mad when touched or wielded.

angles.text: As a night elf, you face a tragic shock in Starbreeze Village's fall. Even the newly grown World Tree is vulnerable to the demonic taint your people fought so hard to eradicate.
As a druid, you face an urgent threat to Ban'ethil Barrow Den and the Cenarion Circle. Your sleeping brothers are vulnerable to the corrupted Gnarlpine tribe.
